name: Tempest Dragon
description: A storm-forged dragon that channels the raw power of tempests. Its Charge Metal blade tears through defenses like lightning through clouds, growing more ferocious as the battle rages on.

ability.name: Tempest Charge
ability.description: Each Attack win generates a Tempest Stack (+12 ATK, max 4). At 4 stacks, Tempest Dragon unleashes Storm Break — dealing 50 true damage and resetting stacks. Additionally, each stack increases Special Move damage by +10.

chain._note: Storm Break: 50 true damage at 4 stacks, resets

special_move.name: Tempest Charge Strike
special_move.description: The Dragon ignites in storm energy and unleashes three thundering charges across the stadium!
flavour_texts: 🐉 **Strike 3** — TEMPEST CHARGE STRIKE — STORM DRAGON FINAL ROAR!
